audit.whatIsWrong: The full-layer level chart reads "Skill" on all seven rows while the content layer (win[0..6]) and the packet chart both read Karma/Karma/Karma/Annie/Annie/Annie/Annie. The page renders two different answers to "who wins Level 1".
audit.why: Karma has 950 range on Inner Flame versus Annie's 625 Q, Mantra is available at level 1 without a skill point, and Annie has no way to close before Tibbers. After level 6 the point-and-click stun plus Tibbers beats a kit with no dash and no burst answer, matching Annie's 54.91% win rate over 1914 games.
audit.corrected: phases[0..2].side = Karma, phases[3..6].side = Annie, with ratings 4/4/4/6/7/7/7. win[0..6] already matches on disk, so only the full layer needs the flip.

audit.why: Level 6 Tibbers, Luden's/Stormsurge and Rabadon's are the real spikes and are already recorded. Karma's spike is Mantra itself at level 1 plus the Q cooldown falling from 9s to 5s by rank 5, which the cooldown section now states.

audit.whatIsWrong: Karma is referred to as "he/his" in five fields. The decisive interactions are never stated: Focused Resolve is a break-on-range tether (12s flat), Mantra-Q leaves a delayed cataclysm on the ground, and Karma's passive Gathering Fire cuts Mantra's 40/38/36/34s cooldown every time she lands a damaging spell.
audit.why: Riot's W text says explicitly "If the tether is not broken, the enemy will be rooted" — Molten Shield's move-speed burst is Annie's tool for breaking that range before the root lands. Riot's passive text says her damaging abilities reduce Mantra's cooldown, so a Mantra you did not see spent may be back far earlier than 40s.
audit.corrected: Rewrote breakdown.cooldowns, enemyWin, breakdown.feeding, breakdown.carry, tradeGood, tradeBad, breakdown.trading and dosFull[1..2] around these three interactions.

audit.whatIsWrong: packet.defects flags zero cooldown-sequencing advice, and breakdown.cooldowns carried no numbers at all.
audit.why: Focused Resolve is 12s flat at every rank and Inner Flame drops 9s to 5s; those two numbers are what make "step up on the cast" actionable.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns now names the 12s tether, the 9s-to-5s Q, and the E-breaks-range answer.

audit.whatIsWrong: No anti-heal mention despite Mantra-W healing Karma through the tether.
audit.why: missingInteractions flags needs-antiheal, and Riot's W Mantra text says she heals herself while the link is strengthened. Extended trades flip on Grievous Wounds timing.
audit.corrected: report[8].t now buys Oblivion Orb when she outlasts you.
